chunks: When your Lord revealed to the angels: 'I am with you; so strengthen those who have believed. I will cast terror into the hearts of those who disbelieved; so strike [their] necks and strike from them every finger.'
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of striking the necks and every finger in Surah Al-Anfal?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a direct divine intervention during the Battle of Badr, where Allah Himself commanded the angels to stabilize the hearts of the believers and instill fear in the disbelievers. The command to strike the necks and joints is viewed not merely as a tactical instruction but as a manifestation of divine support (tawfiq) ensuring the triumph of the faithful against overwhelming odds, highlighting the spiritual dimension of physical combat.
